20 hours of its exercise would take it from 61 to about 64, worth about 0.7 points a piece on your recent work (1 of your last 1 piece read it; it gains most on The Second Answer (The God Speaks Through Her), Taped, about +0.5), worked out again with you as you are now, a session a day; about 0.2 of it is the discipline 20 days of practice keep, which any exercise kept up daily would bring.
